units.source_text: 信子的表兄俊吉，那时候还在大学的文科系读书，

en.t: Nobuko's cousin Shunkichi was still studying in the humanities department at the university then,

units.source_text: 他也希望自己将来可以称为作家。

en.t: and he too hoped that someday he might be called a writer.

units.source_text: 信子和自己的这位大学生师兄一直来往频繁，

en.t: Nobuko had long been in frequent contact with this university senior of hers,

units.source_text: 而且，他们之间还有文学这个共同爱好，

en.t: and besides, the two of them shared an interest in literature,
so they gradually became more intimate.

units.source_text: 俊吉对以托尔斯泰为代表的主流文学思想毫无敬业，

en.t: Shunkichi had no respect at all for the mainstream literary ideas represented by Tolstoy,

units.source_text: 他总是显摆那些法国舶来的讽言警语。

en.t: and he was always showing off those ironic aphorisms imported from France.

units.source_text: 经常会让凡事坚持谨慎严肃的信子生气。

en.t: often made Nobuko, who insisted on being careful and serious in everything, angry.

units.source_text: 但是也认为俊吉的讽言警语中也有一种不能被轻视的东西。

en.t: she also felt that there was something in Shunkichi's ironic aphorisms that could not be taken lightly.
